info.title: Kavel Anonymous Task API
info.description:
The keyless GET side of Kavel's anonymous AI image API: polling a generation task for its status and result image URLs. Anonymous output is 1K and watermarked.

Sources: https://kavel.readthedocs.io/en/latest/sdk/http/ and the reference it links, https://hanshs474.gitbook.io/kavel-api/kavel-anonymous-image-api.md, with the poll endpoint probed live on 2026-10-23 using the task id from that reference (2a04f52a-0da3-4629-8a3f-ecc5a507f34f), which still answers with a finished result, and with an unknown task id.

NOT modelled: POST /api/ai/generate, which submits a job and is the only way to obtain a new task id. It is not GET, it spends credits from a small per-client wallet (15 credits; 5 per text-to-image, 15 per edit) under a 30-credit per-IP daily ceiling, and it was not probed. Without it this spec can only read tasks whose id is already known. Observed but unexplained: the image URL in a finished task changed between two polls of the same task. The `x-anon-id` header the docs say to send on the poll is not required: the probe without it returned the same result. Unverified: the item type of `videos` (always empty; assumed URL strings) and any status other than success.

get.description: Returns the task's status and, once it has succeeded, its result image URLs. Status is not monotonic (processing can go back to pending); only success and failed are final. An unknown task id still answers HTTP 200, with code -1, message `query ai task failed` and no data.

parameters.name: taskId
parameters.description: Task id returned when the job was submitted.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Generation provider; `kie` for every documented model.

parameters.name: mediaType
parameters.description: Media type of the task; `image` on the anonymous tier.

200.description: The task. `code` is 0 on success and -1 on failure (then `data` is absent).

Task.description: State of an image generation task.

status.description: pending, processing, success or failed. Only success and failed are final.

images.description: Result image URLs, present once the task has succeeded.

watermarked.description: One flag per image; anonymous output is watermarked.

videos.description: Result video URLs (always empty on the anonymous tier, which cannot run video).
